description: Provider integration acceptance matrix and post-merge retest checklist for Universal Computer Use Runtime.

semanticActionSuccessRate.rule: Semantic actions count as successful only when afterVerification.success=true or the provider reports an explicit unsupported safe path.

backgroundActionSuccessRate.rule: Background invoke/type actions must not move the foreground cursor and must pass post-action verification.

wrongClickRiskWeightedScore.rule: Any high-until-verified case must include fallback traceability and post-action verification evidence.

averageVerificationConfidence.rule: Unsupported safe paths may report 0 confidence only when explicitly skipped with environmentUnsupported.

postActionVerificationSuccessRate.rule: No provider action can be counted successful without afterVerification.success=true or an explicit unsupported skip.

backgroundReadCoverageRate.rule: Core, Windows, macOS, and Browser providers must all report whether backgroundRead is supported.

backgroundInvokeCoverageRate.rule: Windows native, macOS AX, and Browser DOM actions should expose at least one background invoke path.

backgroundTypeCoverageRate.rule: Windows UIA ValuePattern and Browser DOM type paths should expose background type when supported.

foregroundFallbackRate.rule: requiresForeground=true is acceptable only when the report includes a reason and post-action verification.

visionFallbackRate.rule: visionFallbackNeeded=true must include evidence that semantic provider lookup was attempted first.

hidFallbackRate.rule: HID fallback is acceptable only with traceId, click target evidence, and after-action verification.

fallbackTraceabilityRate.rule: Every fallbackUsed[] entry must include type, reason, and traceId.

providerMatrix.scope: Provider registry, routing, selector/action/capability schema, canonical report emission.

capabilityFields.passCriteria: Every report case has all capability fields as booleans; unsupported provider paths use explicit status/riskFlags instead of omitted fields.

selectorFields.passCriteria: Selector is serializable in canonical report and stable enough to replay or diagnose.

actionVerification.passCriteria: Action success is never inferred from dispatch alone; report records pre-state and post-state evidence.

fallbackTraceability.passCriteria: Core preserves provider fallback chain order and exposes fallback rates in metrics.

blockingFailures: Missing capability field in any case
Action marked pass=true while afterVerification.success=false and not explicitly skipped

providerMatrix.scope: Windows UIA/Win32/IAccessible provider and existing Claw compatibility path.

capabilityFields.passCriteria: Native controls use UIA read and patterns before foreground/HID fallback.

selectorFields.passCriteria: automationId outranks exact name+controlType; OCR text is not used as direct click center when a UIA neighbor exists.

actionVerification.passCriteria: Notepad and Calculator scenarios pass with semantic method and confidence >= 0.9.

fallbackTraceability.passCriteria: HID fallback includes UIA failure reason and verification screenshot or state evidence.

blockingFailures: Native Windows scenario goes straight to HID without UIA attempt
OCR fallback clicks text center without UIA neighborhood matching
Type action lacks post-action value/focus verification

providerMatrix.scope: macOS AX provider skeleton/live implementation and permission-aware safe path.

capabilityFields.passCriteria: AX provider reports capability even when Accessibility or Screen Recording permission is missing.

selectorFields.passCriteria: AX selector is stable across focus changes; unsupported path records environmentUnsupported.

actionVerification.passCriteria: macos-ax-demo-button either passes live with confidence >= 0.8 or skips with explicit unsupported reason.

fallbackTraceability.passCriteria: macOS fallback chain records permission boundary and does not masquerade HID as AX.

blockingFailures: macOS unavailable case fails without skip reason
AX action counted successful without AX state verification
Screen capture or HID fallback used without permission/risk flag

providerMatrix.scope: Browser DOM/CDP provider or Playwright-like adapter.

capabilityFields.passCriteria: DOM/CDP read, type, and submit paths do not require foreground for DOM-backed controls.

selectorFields.passCriteria: CSS selector for local Baidu-like fixture is replayable and appears in report.

required: navigation or mutation evidence when applicable
actionVerification.passCriteria: browser-baidu-dom-search passes with confidence >= 0.98 and no foreground/vision/HID fallback.

fallbackTraceability.passCriteria: Canvas fallback is separate from DOM success path and reports why DOM could not target it.

blockingFailures: DOM action lacks after-action DOM assertion
Canvas fallback is reported as DOM success

providerMatrix.scope: Vision/OCR/HID fallback orchestration shared by providers.

capabilityFields.passCriteria: Fallback capability fields are explicit and visible in metrics, never hidden as provider success.

selectorFields.passCriteria: Vision/OCR selector includes evidence bounds and source attempt, not only raw coordinates.

actionVerification.passCriteria: fallback-canvas-vision-ocr-hid passes only with fallback trace and post-action verification.

blockingFailures: Vision/OCR fallback without source provider miss reason

postMergeRetestSequence.expectedOutput: 1 passing test; validates canonical scenarios, report metrics, post-merge report, and provider acceptance matrix shape

postMergeRetestSequence.command: Run the Core owner smoke command from post-merge-acceptance-report.json when src/computer-use is present in the integration worktree.
postMergeRetestSequence.expectedOutput: ProviderRegistry registers Windows/Browser/macOS providers or returns explicit blocked reason; capability report is visible.

postMergeRetestSequence.command: Start Chrome/Edge with --remote-debugging-port=9222 and run the Browser provider live smoke documented in docs/computer-use-benchmark.md.
postMergeRetestSequence.expectedOutput: DOM snapshot, selector, click/type, and post-action verification evidence for browser-baidu-dom-search.

postMergeRetestSequence.command: Run the Windows provider Notepad/Calculator mutate smoke documented in docs/computer-use-benchmark.md.
postMergeRetestSequence.expectedOutput: UIA read/selector/Invoke/Value/Selection evidence plus post-action verification; fallback reason if needed.

postMergeRetestSequence.command: On macOS, grant Accessibility/Automation/Screen Recording and run the AX demo fixture or provider smoke.
postMergeRetestSequence.expectedOutput: AX capability report, TCC status, selector/action verification, or explicit unsupported reason.
